ic_name: System Management Bus (SMBus 3.1) + Power Management Bus (PMBus 1.3)

fsm_states.name: IDLE
fsm_states.description: Bus free; device listening for a START and its address. PMBus output may be off.

fsm_states.name: START
fsm_states.description: Master drives a START condition (SMBDAT falls while SMBCLK high).

fsm_states.name: ADDRESS
fsm_states.description: Master shifts the 7-bit address + R/W bit; the addressed slave ACKs.

fsm_states.name: COMMAND
fsm_states.description: For Write/Read Byte/Word/Block and PMBus, the command code byte is transferred and ACK'd.

fsm_states.name: DATA
fsm_states.description: Data byte(s) transferred MSB-first, each ACK/NACK'd; Block transfers include a Byte Count.

fsm_states.name: PEC
fsm_states.description: Optional Packet Error Code (CRC-8) byte transferred and checked before STOP.

fsm_states.name: STOP
fsm_states.description: Master drives a STOP condition (SMBDAT rises while SMBCLK high); bus returns to IDLE.

fsm_states.name: ALERT_RESPONSE
fsm_states.description: On SMBALERT# low the host issues Receive Byte to the ARA; alerting devices arbitrate and the winner returns its address.

fsm_states.name: ARP
fsm_states.description: Address Resolution: Prepare-to-ARP / Get-UDID / Assign-Address at the Device Default Address.

fsm_states.name: FAULT
fsm_states.description: (PMBus) a monitored quantity crossed a limit: STATUS bits set, SMBALERT# asserted, configured fault response taken.

fsm_states.name: TIMEOUT
fsm_states.description: SMBCLK held low past Ttimeout; master aborts, slave releases the bus and resets its interface.

pmbus_output_control_logic.rule: ON_OFF_CONFIG selects whether the output is enabled by the CONTROL pin, by the OPERATION command, by both (AND), or by neither, and sets CONTROL polarity and turn-off behavior.

fsm_hints.trigger: A START + matching address begins a transaction; STOP ends it. SMBALERT# low triggers the Alert Response sequence.
fsm_hints.rule: If PEC is enabled, the CRC-8 over the whole transaction is checked before the data is committed; a mismatch NACKs the transaction.
fsm_hints.abort: Clock-low past Ttimeout (25-35 ms) aborts the transaction and resets the slave interface.

anti_deadlock_rule: SMBus bus timeouts (Ttimeout / Tlow:sext / Tlow:mext) guarantee a hung device cannot lock the bus indefinitely — the master aborts and all devices release the bus, returning to IDLE. This is the key robustness addition over base I2C.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on/reset a device enters IDLE with its output off (PMBus), listening for its address. It adopts its address either from hardware strapping or, if ARP-capable, from the ARP master via Assign-Address. PMBus output enable then follows OPERATION + CONTROL pin + ON_OFF_CONFIG.

configurations.name: PEC enabled
configurations.description: Every transaction carries a CRC-8 PEC byte for integrity.

configurations.name: SMBALERT# / ARA
configurations.description: Shared interrupt with host-driven Alert Response.

configurations.name: PMBus multi-rail
configurations.description: PAGE selects the rail; group/zone commands coordinate devices.
